purpose: Complete the unchanged 4032 new 3B development contexts using the diagnostically compatible cached pair path; preserve the original failed run.
selection_rule: Predeclared fastest compatible one-pass timing from the frozen 20-context numerical study; not evidence of a general speed ranking.
production_order: Exactly the original 4032 IDs, hashes and token counts in the frozen failed-run plan.

numerical_checks.diagnostic_contexts: Original ten diagnostic contexts plus their actual production-pair companions; at most twenty total.
numerical_checks.overlap_selection: Exactly the ten IDs in the hash-bound numerical study manifest; require the unchanged selector to reproduce them.

benchmark.reserve: 80 times maximum measured single diagnostic duration times 1.2 plus 30 seconds

failure_rule: Any failed numerical or timing gate preserves failure and partial artifacts. Never relax tolerances, change samples, switch paths, or retry automatically.
provenance: New execution protocol, raw score schema, source commit and source hashes. Do not rewrite old 7B, old 3B reused rows, or the failed predecessor.
